استديموا (form X)
# اُسْتُدِيمُوا (ustudīmū) /us.tu.diː.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَدَامَ (istadāma)
# اِسْتَدِيمُوا (istadīmū) /is.ta.diː.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَدَامَ (istadāma)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
